model_scope: Executable Monte Carlo posterior inference for a single kilonova event with nuisance ejecta mass, electron fraction, and inclination; hierarchical extension across events is design-only.

parameter_requests.meaning: Fission neutron release timescale inferred as the primary nuclear physics parameter.
retrieval_queries: delayed fission neutron release timescale for r-process nuclei in neutron-star merger ejecta
nuclear theory constraints on fission timescales relevant to kilonova nucleosynthesis

parameter_requests.meaning: Ejecta mass nuisance parameter controlling kilonova luminosity and opacity.
retrieval_queries: kilonova ejecta mass constraints from gravitational-wave and electromagnetic observations
dynamical ejecta mass estimates for neutron-star mergers

parameter_requests.meaning: Initial electron fraction of the ejecta controlling neutron richness.
retrieval_queries: initial electron fraction distributions for neutron-star merger ejecta
electron fraction constraints in r-process kilonova models

parameter_requests.meaning: Binary inclination angle relative to the observer line of sight.
retrieval_queries: inclination angle constraints for binary neutron star mergers from gravitational-wave and kilonova observations

parameter_requests.meaning: Number of posterior samples requested from the Monte Carlo solver.
Number of independent Markov chains used for convergence assessment.
Number of temperature levels used by the parallel tempering sampler.

scientific_question: What is the posterior probability distribution of the fission neutron release timescale when gravitational-wave, kilonova photometric, and spectroscopic abundance constraints are combined?
symbolic_model_intent: Bayesian hierarchical posterior for a common fission timescale with event-specific astrophysical nuisance parameters marginalized using gravitational-wave, photometric, and spectroscopic likelihood contributions.
title: Hierarchical Bayesian Inference of Fission Timescales from Multi-Messenger Kilonova Constraints
